arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 20 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Condition' AND LOWER(concept_name) = 'asthma' ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_id

WITH asthma_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 317009
), rescue_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 1154343 AS ingredient_concept_id, 'albuterol' AS ingredient_name UNION ALL
    SELECT 1192218, 'levalbuterol' UNION ALL
    SELECT 1112921, 'ipratropium' UNION ALL
    SELECT 1343916, 'epinephrine' UNION ALL
    SELECT 1236744, 'terbutaline'
), rescue_exposures AS (
    SELECT
        ri.ingredient_name,
        ri.ingredient_concept_id,
        de.person_id,
        de.drug_exposure_id
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN asthma_patients ap
      ON ap.person_id = de.person_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor dca
      ON dca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    JOIN rescue_ingredients ri
      ON ri.ingredient_concept_id = dca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT
    ingredient_name AS rescue_medication,
    COUNT(*) AS dispensings_or_exposures,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS asthma_patients_dispensed
FROM rescue_exposures
GROUP BY ingredient_name
ORDER BY dispensings_or_exposures DESC;

Among asthma patients, the most frequently dispensed rescue medications were:

| Rank | Rescue medication | Dispensing/exposure records | Asthma patients dispensed |
|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | Albuterol | 1,770,751 | 84,987 |
| 2 | Ipratropium | 680,757 | 25,079 |
| 3 | Epinephrine | 380,853 | 43,603 |
| 4 | Levalbuterol | 108,631 | 3,880 |
| 5 | Terbutaline | 14,383 | 4,560 |

I defined asthma patients using OMOP descendants of SNOMED `Asthma` concept `317009`, and rescue medications by RxNorm ingredient concepts for albuterol, levalbuterol, ipratropium, epinephrine, and terbutaline.
